fieldValues.title: What a pull request must carry differs in every repository
fieldValues.statement: When I open a pull request, each repository asks for something different: srs wants a Mode, Cell and Door line checked in CI, srs-web wants Closes #N and a branch name pattern, muDemocracy.org wants MECHANICAL, JUDGEMENT or OWNER, the clerk grades grounding from the issue. Five repos each have their own PR template and nothing states once what a good pull request is, so PRs fail checks they could not have known about, or pass with nothing that lets a reviewer judge them.
source_ref: finding 157dc2a3: 11 of the last 20 merged srs PR bodies would fail the classification check
